name: Plansee
kurzbeschreibung: The crystal-clear Plansee , nestled at the foot of the Ammergauer Alpen, is the largest lake in the Außerfern and perfect for swimming, sailing, and hiking.
preis: Kostenlos (Schifffahrt Einzelfahrt ca. 8–14 €, Parkplatz ca. 5–7 € pro Tag)
beschreibung:
Overview

Lake Plansee stretches as a breathtaking, fjord-like alpine body of water at an altitude of 976 meters in the Außerfern district near Reutte. Covering nearly 2.87 square kilometers with a maximum depth of 78 meters, it is the second-largest natural lake in Tyrol, rivaled only by Lake Achensee. A historic 300-meter canal connects it directly to adjacent Lake Heiterwanger See. Flanked by the precipitous, densely timbered walls of the Ammergau Alps and the sheer limestone crests of the Heiterwand, Plansee captivates visitors with dramatic fjord topography and crystal-clear, nutrient-poor water of certified drinking purity. Beneath sunny skies, its surface sparkles in intense shades of aquamarine and sapphire. Scuba divers across Europe revere the lake for underwater visibility reaching up to 15 meters, while sailors, paddleboarders, and nature purists cherish its pristine shoreline.

Route & Requirements

Outdoor enthusiasts find exceptional options along Plansee's shores. The premier hiking excursion is the shoreline loop: extending roughly 14 kilometers, a well-marked pathway hugs the northern and southern shores through shady beech and spruce woodlands (3.5 to 4 hours walking time, easy to moderate grade T1/T2, minor scrambles over shoreline rocks). Endurance hikers can combine both waterways into the grand "Two Lakes Circuit" (Plansee and Heiterwanger See, 21 km, 5 to 6 hours). The trek can be effortlessly shortened by boarding the historic passenger ships MS Margarethe or MS Wilhelm, which ply the lakes between late May and mid-October, calling at Seespitze, Hotel Forelle, Musteralpe, and Heiterwang. Water sports fans enjoy premier conditions for sailing, windsurfing, stand-up paddling, and diving. Swimmers enjoy numerous natural gravel beaches and manicured sunbathing lawns, with refreshing summer water temperatures between 18 and 21 °C. Sturdy footwear is recommended. Leashed dogs are permitted on trails and at designated swimming bays.

Visit & Arrival

Rail travelers reach the region via the Außerfernbahn railway into Reutte in Tirol station. From Reutte terminal, regional VVT bus line 154 travels directly along Plansee (stops at Hotel Forelle and Musteralpe). Drivers follow federal highway B179 (Fernpass route) into Reutte, branching onto the scenic provincial road L255 toward Ammerwald and Bavaria's Linderhof Palace, which traces the lake shore. Arriving from Germany via Oberammergau is toll- and vignette-free. Pay-and-display parking is provided at Seespitze, Hotel Forelle, and Musteralpe.

Tips

Plan a gourmet stop at the historic Musteralpe dairy on the eastern shore: watch artisanal cheese makers craft wheels of alpine mountain cheese, best savored on the sun deck paired with fresh farmhouse sourdough bread. Purchase a combined boat-and-hike ticket to glide across the water on one leg while walking the panoramic shoreline on the other.
